R1.description: One authoritative deterministic inventory of runnable tests (controller discover-equivalent plus managed conformance suites), refusing import failures and duplicates

R2.description: Explicit targeted selection by module/class/test/suite name; existing python -m unittest and scripts/ suite entry points unchanged

R3.description: Serial and sharded execution of the same selection are equivalent: union equals the selection, shards disjoint, nothing skipped or duplicated, proven by property tests and verified at run time

R4.description: Historical timing data is collected and persisted (committed CI profile, local cache) with an explicit update policy and sensible estimates for unknown tests

R5.description: Timing data is optimization metadata only: missing, stale or corrupt timing data never changes which tests run

R6.description: Adaptive shard count from estimated runtime, clamped to profile bounds, with measured parameter values

R7.description: Duration-balanced deterministic assignment that keeps fixture-sharing atoms whole and reports oversized atoms

R8.description: A straightforward local command running a full or selected suite with the shared planner, bounded concurrency and one aggregated result

R9.description: CI shard matrix generated dynamically from the same planner, full suite still executed and coverage checked, no hand-curated inventory

R10.description: Per-shard isolation of temporary directories, state roots, caches, process groups and signals, with leak detection

R11.description: An explicit auditable serialization mechanism, and latent timing assumptions exposed by parallel load fixed at their cause

R12.description: Failures identify the failing tests, shard, logs and reproduction commands; crashed shards list not-run tests

R13.description: Measured baseline, bottleneck profile and re-measured performance acceptance

R14.description: Released Controller 1.2.0 artefact, wheel packaging scope, version and release pipeline classification preserved; the only Controller runtime change is amendment 0's Design H; documentation updated

R15.description: Controller ownership provenance: an owned process's recorded source reflects its current ownership basis and is published when it changes, without changing ownership membership or any decision made from it (amendment 0, IR1-003)
